note: `gap_analysis` reports a gap's size, direction, and whether it later filled, but not how the session actually closed relative to its open — so UNH shows an unfilled +7.4% gap while `pct_change_1d` is only +1.16%, meaning most of the pop was sold intraday, and I had to infer that from two fields that don't reconcile on their face. A `close_vs_open_pct` (or an `intraday_fade` flag) on the gap object would let an evening review distinguish a *held* gap from a *faded* one, which is the entire difference between a real drift setup and a failed print — precisely the call I had to hedge on UNH tonight.
